tools.name: search
tools.description: Generic connector search (the shape ChatGPT connectors and deep research call). Search Thea (a place-first knowledge graph: 1.07M Korean places from public data, plus people, works and organizations) by name or by 'region + kind', e.g. '여주 온천', '명일동 중식', 'IU'. tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Generic connector fetch: the full Thea entry for an id from search, as Markdown text (fields, links, recent records, sources, licence). thea_entry returns the same entry as JSON.

tools.name: thea_search
tools.description: Find one entry whose name you know. Thea is not a search engine; it is knowledge curated by people, so it returns a trimmed entry (about 1,000 characters), not a scraped page. You may use it in your answer as it is. If several entries share the name, they are listed in 'candidates'; always check it.

tools.name: thea_find
tools.description: Browse by conditions when you have no name. Questions like 'camping YouTubers who posted a new video recently' or 'hotels in 서귀포' cannot be answered by thea_search. Each filter multiplies: more filters, narrower list; subject alone is broad. Subject codes (Korean/English, with aliases): https://thea

tools.name: thea_entry
tools.description: Full view of one entry: all fields, its connections (each with an id), and its satellites: dated events attached to it (new videos, albums, awards, appearances), newest first, 5 by default, with satellites_total per type. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
